test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MUSIC' is written as ‘LNTVRTHJBD’ and 'VIOLIN' is written as 'UWHJNPKMHJMO’. How will 'CHORD' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is :** Each letter of the given word is coded as its previous as well as following letter.**

• 'MUSIC' is written as ‘LNTVRTHJBD’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/017302ce927ae6bc2e37eb007336b3440a03f9ee94a676d1a578912951ed5e28.png] 

• 'VIOLIN' is written as 'UWHJNPKMHJMO’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df46c903d79802c15b502c27b4168ac63ee6c8ea0cb824b0d9b76de6d87217ac.png] 

Similarly, 'CHORD' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccb411b1bd5f564d089d9a8446711a45ed809c60bd0bd94756e312f9f2d40898.png] 

Hence,** 'option 2' **is the correct answer.
